body:
Computing the viewport's corners with `±viewport_half` assumes it's symmetrical.
This is not always the case (e.g. with cameras in `FRUSTUM` mode, or `ORTHOGONAL` mode with left ≠ right or top ≠ bottom,  or with OpenXR - see #104249).

The actual corners should be computed instead, either by intersecting the frustum planes, or directly from the projection matrix (I just proposed an implementation in #104311)
This has already been refactored the right way by https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/99974
